title: Keep Windows upgrades recoverable and Linux trash operations safe across filesystems.
changes: Refuse to replace a customized PowerShell launcher before staging or swapping an existing Windows installation; preserve it intact on failure.
Recognize only the complete canonical npm PowerShell launcher when deciding whether to remove its shadow of the verified cmd launcher.
Permit repairing a missing Windows batch launcher during an otherwise verified npm-owned upgrade.
Move Linux directories to a source-local, guarded trash directory when the home trash is on a different filesystem; preserve the original cross-filesystem behavior for regular files.
Keep previous Windows argv, focus, reconnect and event-log fixes; cover Linux cross-device and native Windows installer scenarios with regression tests.
